en: Black‑and‑white image of a long, multi‑storey institutional building with brick and stone façades, mansard‑style roof sections, tall chimneys, and arched windows. The structure stands behind a brick-and-iron fence with young trees planted along a wide, empty street in the foreground. Large mature trees frame the scene on both sides. Another similar multi‑storey building is visible further down the street. There is no visible printed caption or other text on the front.
